analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: S&P 500: while 7710 holds as support, the desk expects an up-move toward 7750, with 7790 in extension. A break below 7710 would trigger a down-move toward 7670, with 7630 in extension.
DAX: while 25,250 holds as support, the desk expects an up-move toward 25,430, with 25,505 in extension. A break below 25,250 would trigger a down-move toward 25,100, with 25,000 in extension.
EuroStoxx50: while 6115 holds as support, the desk expects an up-move toward 6160, with 6200 in extension. A break below 6115 would trigger another test of the 200-day moving average at 6100.
SMI: while 14,435 holds as support, the desk expects an up-move toward 14,535, with 14,605 in extension. A break below 14,435 would trigger a down-move toward 14,375, with 14,250 in extension.

Trend calls: intraday is up for all four indices while above their support levels. The 2-5 day trend is neutral for the S&P 500 and DAX, down for EuroStoxx50 (below 6200), and up for the SMI (above 14,250).
